notes.title: Wechselbalg Studio Launches "3 Tower" in Early Access on Steam with 20% Discount
notes.notes: [p]We are proud to announce that [i]3 Tower[/i], the atmospheric horror game that blends eerie storytelling with intense survival gameplay, is now available in Early Access on Steam.[/p][p]To celebrate the launch, [i]3 Tower[/i] is currently available at a [b]20% discount[/b] for a limited time.[/p][p]Set in a mysterious cemetery haunted by troubled souls, players take on the role of a nightwatchman caught between three chilling storylines. As memories return and strange events unfold, players must uncover the truth about the graveyard – and about themselves.[/p][p]“Getting [i]3 Tower[/i] into players’ hands via Early Access is a huge milestone for us,” says Swen Kalini, lead developer at Wechselbalg Studio. “We’re excited to build the game together with the community and expand the haunting world of [i]3 Tower[/i] with your feedback.”[/p][p][b]Key Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Rich, immersive atmosphere with psychological horror elements[/p][/*][*][p]Interwoven storylines with unexpected twists[/p][/*][*][p]Creepy environments, challenging puzzles, and jumpscares that will keep you on edge[/p][/*][*][p]Developed by a two-person team with love, coffee, and lots of late nights[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 🕯 Community Update: We're Sorry for the delay. This Hurts. 🕯
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]This is not the update we wanted to write. Not today.[/p][p][b]We've been holding onto hope until the last possible minute, expecting to share a major milestone with you—something that was [i]supposed[/i] to happen 18th of June.[/b][/p][p]
This date wasn’t picked at random. It meant something deeply personal to us. It marked a promise, a rhythm in our creative journey, and a moment we wanted to share with all of you who believed in [i]3Tower[/i] from day one.[/p][p][b]But Steam… well, they had other plans. Or rather, [i]no plan[/i]—at least none that matched the urgency we poured into this.[/b][/p][p]We've been stuck in their approval limbo for weeks, waiting for a green light that just never came. Emails, tickets, polite nudges… we did everything short of flying to Valve HQ with a lantern and a haunting playlist. The delay isn’t on us. The game is ready. [i]We[/i] are ready. But bureaucracy, slow gears, and radio silence swallowed a launch that was incredibly important to us and, honestly, to this community.[/p][p][b]We’re frustrated. We’re heartbroken. We’re sorry.[/b][/p][p]We don’t like to rant, and we don’t like blaming external forces, but this time, we owe you honesty. This delay doesn’t just mess with timelines—it messes with trust. Yours, and ours.[/p][p][b]So what now?[/b][/p][p]We keep going. [i]3Tower[/i] lives. The graveyard may be full of the restless dead, but we’re not joining them just yet. As soon as we get that Steam OK, we’ll let you know. And we’ll be back with something to make it up to you. That’s a promise.[/p][p][b]Thank you for sticking with us. You deserve better. And we’ll make sure you get it.[/b][/p][p]— Swen, Jasmin, and the whole Wechselbalg Studio team 🖤[/p]

notes.title: 🪦 3Tower is Now in Early Access! 🕯️
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Watchers of the Graveyard,[/p][p]It’s time! [i]3Tower[/i] has officially entered [b]Early Access[/b], and you can [b]play it right now[/b].[/p][p]Step into your role as the night watchman of a very peculiar cemetery. Strange events are unfolding, the dead are restless, and you're at the center of it all. [i]3Tower[/i] offers three branching storylines filled with mystery, jumpscares, and dark atmosphere — and this is just the beginning.[/p][p][b]Why Early Access?[/b]
Because we want [i]you[/i] to be part of this journey. Your feedback will help shape the evolution of the Graveyard — from balance tweaks and story pacing to what might be unearthed next.[/p][p][b]A few quick notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Controller support[/b] is coming later, with the Linux version (ETA: 2–3 months).[/p][/*][*][p]There may still be some ghostly bugs lurking — we’re watching closely and patching fast![/p][/*][*][p]Updates will roll out based on your feedback, reviews, and ghostly whispers in the night.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you so much for following and supporting us — this project means the world to us, and we’re thrilled to finally share it with you.[/p][p]Now grab a lantern, steel your nerves… and enter [i]3Tower[/i].
🕷️[/p][p]— Swen & Jasmin
[i]Wechselbalg Studio[/i][/p]

notes.title: 3Tower – Slight Delay Incoming 👀🪦
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Quick update from the depths of the Graveyard: [i]3Tower[/i] is [b]coming a few days later than expected.[/b] We're now aiming to release it within the [b]next 10 days[/b].[/p][p]Why the delay? Well… a couple of small-but-mighty [i]oopsi-fucks[/i] crept into the Steam page. 😅[/p][list][*][p]Some info was missing—stuff Steam didn’t mark as mandatory, but turns out, actually is.[/p][/*][*][p]We also had a mislabel: [b]controller support[/b] is [i]not[/i] available at launch. That’ll arrive later, together with the [b]Linux build[/b], which is planned for release in 2–3 months.[/p][/*][/list][p]We've gone in, poked around, yelled at some checkboxes, and (hopefully) fixed all the issues. Now we’re just waiting on Steam to give us the final green light again.[/p][p]Thanks for sticking with us! We’d rather take a few extra days to launch this right than stumble out of the crypt half-buried in bugs and wrong settings.[/p][p]Love from the Graveyard,
— Swen & Jasmin
[i]Wechselbalg Studio[/i][/p]

notes.title: 3Tower Release Announcement – August 18, 2025
notes.notes:
[p]We’re proud to announce that [i]3Tower[/i] will be available on [b]August 18th, 2025[/b].[/p][p]This haunting journey through the Graveyard of 3Tower marks more than just a game release for us. It’s a beginning born from both creativity and deep emotion.[/p][p]The date is no coincidence. It’s been exactly ten years since we lost our daughter Hailey during childbirth. What was once the saddest day in our lives now becomes a moment to share something new—something meaningful. [i]3Tower[/i] is, in many ways, a tribute to life, memory, and the strange beauty that can emerge from grief.[/p][p]We know [i]3Tower[/i] is just the beginning. There will be patches, and we're listening closely to your feedback. How the story of the 3Tower Graveyard continues will depend in part on your experiences and reviews.[/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey.
– Swen & Jasmin
[i]Wechselbalg Studio[/i][/p]

notes.title: Wechselbalg Studio is Competing in the Game Developer World Championship
notes.notes:
Exciting news from the Wechselbalg Studio team! We are thrilled to announce that 3Tower is officially participating in the Game Developer World Championship (GDWC), a global celebration of creativity, innovation, and indie game development.

To mark this milestone, we will be releasing a playable demo of 3Tower in the coming days. This is your chance to step into the chilling world of our haunted cemetery, take on the role of the night watchman, and experience the eerie atmosphere, suspenseful storytelling, and spine-chilling scares that have defined our vision for this game.

We've poured our hearts into crafting a unique horror experience that blends immersive storytelling, atmospheric level design, and intense moments of terror. Whether you're a seasoned horror fan or just looking for a fresh indie game to get your adrenaline pumping, we can't wait for you to take your first steps into the shadowy paths of 3Tower.

Stay tuned for more updates, including the official demo release date, and don't forget to wishlist 3Tower on your favorite platform to stay in the loop.

Thank you for supporting indie games and helping us make 3Tower a reality. See you on the other side... if you dare!

Stay spooky,
The Wechselbalg Studio Team
